messages:
maya (platform): Heads up — saw weird project attribution for service-account keys in the canary window this morning. Some requests are getting billed to the org project instead of the originating project.
aditya (eng): ack. do you have a sample trace or logs?
maya (platform): yes — snippet below (redacted). notice the origin vs exchange headers and missing claim.project

```
# request log
req_id=abc123 svc=auth router=proxy node=proxy-b-3 origin="proj:alpha" exchange="sa:billing" claims="{sub:sa-42}" -> attributed_project=null
```
ryan (obs): hmm looks like our attribution rule falls back to exchange when claim.project absent. we need to see frequency before changing logic.
jen (product): impact on customers? any ones hitting quota surprises?
maya (platform): small sample but high variance across short bursts. two customers flagged unexpected quota usage.
samir (security): is there any chance tokens are forged/impersonated? claims missing is concerning.
aditya (eng): unlikely forged; more likely some proxy path strips claims header during proxy->edge exchange. Ops path does token-exchange: curl below
```
curl -X POST https://auth/exchange -H 'Authorization: Bearer ...' -d '{"from":"sa:xyz","to":"proj:alpha"}'
# response includes access_token without claim.project field in some branches
```
ops-bot: deploy pipeline:auth-exchange v1.3.7 -> canary (proxy-b-3)
ryan (obs): proposal: add telemetry metric `attribution.missing_claims` and sample 1% of affected requests with full headers for debugging.
jen (product): console UX ask: show "key provenance" in key detail page (origin, exchange path, last-attributed-project) so support can triage faster.
maya (platform): agree. even a small breadcrumb would cut down time-to-resolution. UX concern: exposing internal exchange chain — need redaction rules.
samir (security): redact raw tokens. store only path metadata (origin, exchanged_to, claim_present boolean).
aditya (eng): implementation plan: two changes
- change attribution precedence: prefer claim.project > origin header > exchange (safe fallback)
- add telemetry + sampled headers for 1% of attribution.mismatch events
we'll gate precedence change behind canary and a feature flag.
jen (product): feature flag name? console toggle?
aditya (eng): `feature.authz.attribution_v2` — console can flip per-org during rollout.
ryan (obs): telemetry snippet (prometheus style)
```
# metrics
attribution_mismatch_total{env="prod",route="/v1/generate"} 42
attribution_missing_claims_sampled{sample=1} 3
```
maya (platform): rollout plan
- enable sampling telemetry immediately (no risk)
- flip attribution_v2 on canary subset (10% traffic) for 24h
- monitor `attribution_mismatch_total` and billing spikes
- if stable, roll to 100% over 48h
jen (product): add console banner for orgs receiving canary saying "Attribution logic changed; contact support if you see quota differences."
samir (security): add audit log entry for any attribution override with actor metadata.
aditya (eng): I'll open PRs: one for telemetry, one for attribution logic, one for console toggle UI. assign owners.
maya (platform): owner list please.
aditya (eng): PRs:
- telemetry: @ryan
- attribution logic + tests: @aditya
- console toggle + banner: @jen
- sampling backend + storage: @maya
maya (platform): cool. can we also add a short-lived debug route to fetch sampled headers for a request id? only for SRE/Devex and with audit checks.
ryan (obs): yes, but restrict to 7-day retention and k/v encryption.
samir (security): require SSO + admin scope to access. log every fetch.
aditya (eng): timeline: telemetry PR by EOD, attribution logic WIP tomorrow, console patch after tests. hoping to flip canary next Tue.
jen (product): I'll draft user-facing note and support playbook.
maya (platform): thanks. ping me if you need more traces — I'll attach a few more anon logs to the ticket.
ops-bot: ticket created: PLAT-1284 "Service key lineage trawl: attribution mismatch" assigned to @aditya, @ryan, @jen, @maya
maya (platform): closing thread for now. will post updates in PLAT-1284. :thumbsup:
